hero.title: The tool that drives your innovation to market
hero.subtitle: Developed by experts in the building and construction sector, Maturoscope helps innovators assess, understand, and accelerate the maturity of their solutions — from idea to market-ready product.

hosts.title: Choose your service provider
hosts.subtitle: Each provider gives you access to Maturoscope, along with services and expert advice tailored to your innovation's stage of development.
hosts.selectLabel: Select a provider to access the questionnaire

whyMaturoscope.body: Are you developing an innovative solution in construction, whether a product, a process or a service? In just a few clicks, the Maturoscope helps you evaluate its maturity and guides you towards the next steps for successful commercialization.
whyMaturoscope.title: Fast, private, and effortless

features.title: Privacy first
features.description: Your data stays yours. Nothing is stored or shared — all responses are deleted as soon as your session ends.

features.title: Less than 12 minutes
features.description: A quick, intuitive self-assessment so you can get back to building what matters.

features.title: No account needed
features.description: Start instantly — no sign-ups, no passwords, no barriers.

scales.title: TRL — Technology Readiness Level
scales.description: Measures how advanced your technology is, from initial concept to validated real-world application.

scales.title: MKRL — Market Readiness Level
scales.description: Assesses how prepared your solution is for market launch, adoption, and scalability.

scales.title: MFRL — Manufacturing Readiness Level
scales.description: Evaluates your ability to produce your solution reliably, efficiently, and at scale.

whatYouGet.title: Clarity and insights in minutes
whatYouGet.subtitle: Answer a few questions and walk away with a clear picture of where your innovation stands, what's holding it back, and what to do next.

steps.title: Understand your innovation's maturity
steps.description: **Discover where your solution stands** across three dimensions — technical, market, and manufacturing readiness — **and identify what's next.**

steps.title: Get your personalized report
steps.description: Instantly download a **tailored PDF report summarizing your results, progress, and key recommendations.**

steps.title: Accelerate your growth
steps.description: Access **customized guidance and services** designed to help you move faster from prototype to market success.

contact.title: Supporting innovation in construction?
contact.subtitle: Join the Maturoscope network and obtain your own matchmaking services tool.
